overall: The AG found the Norwood Hospital Working Group is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it is not empowered to act collectively, so it could not have violated the Law; complaint resolved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Norwood Hospital Working Group is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the Working Group is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law because it fails the second prong of the test as it is not a body empowered to act collectively.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Working Group violated the Law by failing to post meeting notices, hold open meetings, and create and maintain minutes.
allegations.key_passage: As such, the Working Group cannot have violated the Open Meeting Law as alleged.
